scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently --kill-others --names api,web "npm run dev -w @gwmt/api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w mini-jira
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev -w @gwmt/api
scripts.docs: npm run build:contracts && npm run docs -w @gwmt/api
scripts.openapi: npm run build:contracts && npm run openapi -w @gwmt/api
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:contracts && npm run db:seed -w @gwmt/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck -w @gwmt/contracts -w @gwmt/api -w mini-jira
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run test -w @gwmt/contracts -w @gwmt/api
